rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１０Your answer...＝＠００１＿０１１Heh. No need to ask, is there?￥...I'm counting on you.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Amane Depart　－

＊Amane＊＠０１２＿００３Right now, I kinda feel like￥giving myself a pat on the back!￥Because I got to choose you!＝＠０１２＿００４Qualifying, getting to￥bring the sunflowers,￥and...＝＠０１２＿００５getting to go with you, the one￥I love most... I'm so proud￥of all of it!!

＊Amane＊＠０１２＿００３Right now, I kinda feel like￥giving myself a pat on the back!￥Because I got to choose you!＝＠０１２＿００４Qualifying, getting to￥bring the sunflowers,￥and...＝＠０１２＿００６getting to be with you from now￥on, always... I'm so proud￥of all of it!!
＊Amane＊＠０１２＿００７Even when things got hard,￥I'm so glad I never gave up!＝＠０１２＿００８I want you to always be glad￥you're with me. So I'll never￥run away, no matter what!
